Package com.epitech.depthdiablo.combat

Interface Attack

All Known Implementing Classes:
AroundContactAttack, AttackDecorator, Axe, Bow, ContactAttack, Execute, FireStaff, FireTouch, FrontContactAttack, LifeSteal, MeleeWeapon, PlainBow, RangedWeapon, Staff, Sword, Weapon
public interface Attack
What a character's attack does (GDD 1.3.1, 1.6). The equipped weapon is the base attack; passive items wrap it to add effects, such as a burn on every hit (Decorator).

Pattern: Strategy. The character holds an Attack and never knows which weapon is behind it. attack(com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity.character.Character, float, com.epitech.depthdiablo.engine.World) starts an attack (a swing, an arrow) and hit(com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity.character.Character, com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity.character.Character) applies one of its hits.

  • Method Details

    • hit

      default HitResult hit(Character attacker, Character target)
      Applies one hit from the attacker to the target with the damage formula (GDD 1.6): the attacker's ATTACK against the target's DEFENSE. Weapon, armor and passive items already count in both through the builds, so there is no bonus here. Decorators override it to add an effect around the hit (a burn); the others keep this one.
      Parameters:
      attacker - the character who hits
      target - the character who is hit
      Returns:
      what the hit did; HitResult.NONE if it did not land (dead or invincible target)
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if attacker or target is null

    • attack

      void attack(Character owner, float aimDegrees, World world)
      Starts one attack of the owner towards the aim: a sword starts a swing, a bow will shoot an arrow. Only the owner's think calls it, once Character.canAttack() is true.
      Parameters:
      owner - the character who attacks
      aimDegrees - the direction of the attack, in degrees (0 = right, 90 = up)
      world - the world the attack happens in: its entities are the targets, its event bus gets the damage and deaths
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if an argument is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if the aim is not a finite number
      IllegalStateException - if the owner cannot attack now
